text.title: FreshDrop split system, 1–5 August 2026
text.goal: the split system and the significance calculation after the update
text.audience: app users, split by user ID, 50/50
text.runs: 10 re-splits of history, 4 days each; no live traffic
text.decision_rule: if more than 5% of runs are significant, fix the split before the next test
